# TeleBotHost / TBL — LLM docs index
# Site: https://docs.telebothost.com/
# Rule for agents: open ONE page for the task. Do not crawl the whole site.
# Human-readable map: https://docs.telebothost.com/for-agents/

## How to use
1. Match the user task to a topic below.
2. Fetch that single URL.
3. Write TBL code from that page + the bot workspace AGENTS.md rules.
4. Only open a second page if the first is not enough.
